instruction: What do users complain about regarding File bloat, corruption, AUDIT/RECOVER habits in Civil 3D?

(Source: https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Losing-data-when-working-with-DWG-files-in-Desktop-Connector.html; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/File-shows-Conflict-State-in-Desktop-Connector.html; https://help.autodesk.com/view/CIV3D/2023/ENU/?guid=Civil3D_ReleaseNotes_2023_2_1_Release_Notes_2023_2_1_known_issues_html)

instruction: What do users complain about regarding DWG bloat and corruption are routine in CAD products in general?
response: Severity medium: Autodesk lists cloud-sync folders, non-Microsoft networks, NAS/SAN, VPN drops, email and third-party DWG writers as corruption sources; cleanup is a ritual (detach xrefs, OVERKILL, -PURGE regapps, reset scale list, WBLOCK into a new file); files stay ~8 MB after deleting everything; RECOVER can itself stall at 99% or be demanded on every open; field reports of 20 MB to 1.6 GB after pasting a corridor and >100,000 RegApps. (Source: https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Drawing-file-is-not-valid-error-message.html; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/how-to-reduce-the-size-of-a-dwg-file-in-autocad.html; https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/civil-3d-forum/urgent-file-size-is-huge/td-p/13769483 (via sibling notes))

instruction: What do users complain about regarding Autosave and backup have fine print that defeats them in CAD products in general?
response: Severity medium: The autosave timer resets on every manual save so frequent savers may never get an .sv$; autosave stays off if a LISP routine or the Block Editor crashes mid-command; only one .bak generation is kept and none is written when saving to Forma Data Management since 2022.1; the Recovery Manager ignores never-saved drawings; full-time CRC validation is off by default because it slows opening. (Source: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2027/ENU/?guid=GUID-C62ED04D-3638-4EFE-ADA1-5677F7DE7835; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/How-to-ensure-autosave-is-always-on-in-AutoCAD.html; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/File-not-fully-synchronizing-in-Collaboration-for-Civil-3D.html)

instruction: What do users complain about regarding Packaging and binding are lossy in CAD products in general?
response: Severity medium: eTransmit omits SHX/TTF fonts, .pat, .lin, .pmp, OLE links and URL references by default and can silently drop files; Bind renames every named object to name$0$name while Insert silently lets the local definition override the bound one; bind defects (parcel labels to '???', missing profile band labels) persisted across releases. (Source: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2027/PTB/?guid=GUID-C32FA153-88D6-41D9-B868-0DFF59509CD2; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2027/PLK/?guid=GUID-E3039A04-4524-462B-AA27-E5F7DE8C4E9E; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Not-all-files-are-included-in-eTransmit-zip-package-in-AutoCAD-LT.html)

instruction: What do users complain about regarding File locking is delegated to the OS and goes stale in CAD products in general?
response: Severity medium: Since AutoCAD 2000 the program does not control locking; .dwl/.dwl2 exist only for WHOHAS, survive crashes and cause 'in use or read-only' until deleted by hand; cloud drives 'often do not have any type of file locking'. (Source: https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/File-locking-no-longer-controlled-by-software.html; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Error-DWG-file-is-currently-in-use-or-is-read-only.html)

instruction: What do users complain about regarding Fault isolation is done by the user in CAD products in general?
response: Severity medium: Standard remedies for fatal errors are: install updates, reset the user profile, update the GPU driver, uninstall plug-ins, purge/audit/recover, WBLOCK, clean reinstall; many crash classes are add-in, object-enabler or .NET/VC++ runtime interactions rather than core geometry. instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'COGO by bearing and distance'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Metes-and-bounds legal descriptions'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Subdivision plats'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Contour interpolation from spot elevations'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Root cellars'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Passive solar siting and orientation'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Swales, terraces and keyline'?

instruction: What does a site-design CAD need to support the technique 'Dry-stone walls'?
